parsed.position: Use a study-level counting policy: collapse confirmed same-study reports (LR01 and LR02) into one counted study while retaining and linking every report, and keep partial, possible, or distinct-data pairs separate unless verification establishes common study identity.
parsed.reasoning: PRISMA distinguishes reports from underlying studies, so multiple publications from the same trial or fieldwork should not inflate the included-study count. Confidence should guide verification, but collapse should depend on affirmative evidence of shared study identity; partial overlap or similarity of authors, setting, and topic is insufficient. All links should remain documented, and uncertain pairs should be considered for dependence whenever they enter the same synthesis. LR01 must be represented in Family B as one cluster-randomised trial with two companion outcome reports: retain eligible outcomes from both papers, but do not count or weight S294 and S366 as two independent studies, and model or otherwise manage any within-trial outcome dependence.
